Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, proteinuria, and hematuria, with E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL on culture, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Findings are consistent with an active UTI; clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
